findings.message: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read from environment variable, never logged, never written to evidence JSON files. API key is only passed to anthropic.Anthropic client constructor.
findings.checklist_item: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY handling — never logged, never written to evidence JSON

findings.message: Evidence JSON (summary.json, rollup, verdict files) contains no child PII. Only includes scenario_id, run_id, commit_sha, timestamps, and technical state data. No user identifiers, names, or personal data.
findings.checklist_item: Evidence JSON contains no child PII (state sections use session IDs only)

findings.message: Screenshot retry logic implemented with SCREENSHOT_RETRY=3 constant, 1 second delay between attempts. Catches all exceptions during capture.
findings.checklist_item: Retry logic on screenshot capture (3 attempts, 1s delay) is sufficient

findings.message: state_fingerprint function uses json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True) which produces stable, deterministic JSON string for reliable stall detection.
findings.checklist_item: state_fingerprint correctly detects stalls (JSON serialisation is stable)

findings.message: navigate_to action injects action_name via bridge.inject_input with type='action'. Properly waits after injection (wait_after_ms, default 1000ms).
findings.checklist_item: navigate_to action — verify the action_name injection works through bridge

findings.message: Rollup JSON schema compatible with validation. Includes task, tier, run_id, commit_sha, overall_verdict, scenario counts, requirement_ids (line 353), and nested scenarios array.
findings.checklist_item: Rollup JSON is compatible with validate-manual-qa-artifacts.sh expected schema

findings.message: Vision model pinned to 'claude-opus-4-6' constant (line 45). Used consistently in VisionAsserter.assert_screenshot (line 154).
findings.checklist_item: Vision model is pinned to a specific model string (currently claude-opus-4-6)

findings.message: YAML parse errors are NOT caught. yaml.safe_load at line 408 will raise yaml.YAMLError on malformed YAML, crashing the runner. Recommend wrapping in try-except to skip file and continue with other scenarios.
findings.checklist_item: Error handling: bridge down, YAML parse error, API rate limit — all handled gracefully
findings.recommendation: Add try-except around yaml.safe_load to catch YAMLError and print warning instead of crashing

findings.message: No global scenario timeout. Runner relies on step-level wait timeouts only. Long-running scenarios could hang indefinitely if steps don't timeout. Recommend adding --timeout flag and enforcing per-scenario deadline.
findings.checklist_item: Timeout per scenario enforced (currently relies on step-level waits, no global timer)
findings.recommendation: Add per-scenario timeout parameter and deadline check in execute_scenario loop

findings.message: Anthropic client has max_retries=2 by default, providing basic rate limit handling. Vision API errors are caught at line 180. Bridge errors caught throughout (lines 86, 94, 104, 117). Bridge down handled with timeout at lines 382-386.
findings.checklist_item: Error handling: bridge down, YAML parse error, API rate limit — all handled gracefully

acceptance_criteria.scenario_dsl_supports_steps: PASS - Supports assert_visual, assert_state, input, wait_for_event, capture_evidence, navigate_to actions
acceptance_criteria.machine_readable_json_evidence: PASS - Produces step-NN.png, step-NN-verdict.json, summary.json, rollup-tierN-TIMESTAMP.json
acceptance_criteria.integration_with_quality_gates: PASS - Integrated via run-ai-vision-tests.sh entry point, wired into run-quality-gates.sh

summary: APPROVE. TASK-063 Claude vision scenario runner is well-implemented with comprehensive features. Two minor issues identified: (1) YAML parse errors not caught, (2) no global scenario timeout. Both are edge cases that don't block approval. All acceptance criteria met. Integration with CI quality gates verified.
